name: Advanced Cognatogen
body:
Your mutagenic form can enhance your mental abilities rather than your muscles.

Prerequisite(s): Advanced mutagen class feature, cognatogen or inspiring cognatogen discovery.

Benefit(s): You add the following advanced mutagens to the list of those you can select:

Collective Memory (Su)

This cognatogen is identical to the alchemist discovery of the same name and counts as that discovery for the purpose of qualifying for other discoveries or advanced mutagens.

Genius (Ex)

In her mutagenic form, the master chymist’s refined mind gives her an alchemical bonus on Intelligence checks, Wisdom checks, and Intelligence-based skill checks as well as a bonus to concentration checks and caster level.

The bonus is equal to half the master chymist’s class level.

Grand Cognatogen (Su)

This cognatogen is identical to the alchemist discovery of the same name and counts as that discovery for the purpose of qualifying for other discoveries or advanced mutagens. The character must have an effective alchemist level (alchemist level plus chymist level) of at least 16 and must have the collective memory discovery or advanced cognatogen to select this ability. If the master chymist has the inspiring cognatogen discovery, this may instead function as grand inspiring cognatogen.

Greater Cognatogen (Su)

This cognatogen is identical to the alchemist discovery of the same name and counts as that discovery for the purpose of qualifying for other discoveries or advanced mutagens. The character must have an effective alchemist level (alchemist level plus chymist level) of at least 12 and must have the collective memory discovery or advanced cognatogen to select this ability. If the master chymist has the inspiring cognatogen discovery, this may instead function as greater inspiring cognatogen.

Inspired Trick: The master chymist selects an investigator talent to use while she is under the effect of her inspiring cognatogen. This is in addition to other investigator talents gained through inspiring cognatogen discoveries and the inspired chemist archetype.

Perfect Knowledge (Ex)

The master chymist treats all Knowledge skills as class skills, and the bonus gained from the collective memory discovery or advanced cognatogen increases to her class level. The character must have an effective alchemist level (alchemist level plus chymist level) of at least 11 and must have the collective memory discovery or advanced cognatogen to select this ability.

Planar Cognatogen (Su)

When the chymist assumes her mutagenic form, she gains outsider features depending on her alignment. The chymist chooses one outsider subtype when selecting this advanced cognatogen; once selected, this choice cannot be changed. The chymist gains the energy resistances of the selected outsider subtype and may channel positive or negative energy once per transformation into her mutagenic form, curing or inflicting 5d6 points of damage (Will half, DC 10 + the chymist’s class level + the chymist’s Charisma modifier). The character must have an effective alchemist level (alchemist level plus chymist level) of at least 16, must know the infuse self extract, and must have the collective memory discovery or advanced cognatogen to select this ability.

Telepathy (Su)

This cognatogen functions as the universal monster ability of the same name, except that it only applies in the chymist’s mutagenic form.

Youth (Su)

The master chymist gains an additional +2 bonus on a mental ability whenever she imbibes a cognatogen. The character must have an effective alchemist level (alchemist level plus chymist level) of at least 16 and must know the eagle’s splendor, fox’s cunning, or owl’s wisdom extract to select this ability.
